# Sample

## Practice Lab · 5 Questions

### Domain 1

**Q1.** A company mounts visible cameras to discourage theft. Which control type is this? [M1-CAC] A. Corrective · B. Deterrent · C. Compensating · D. Directive

**Q2.** Select two. Which are Zero Trust traits? [M1-CUC] A. Trust the internal network · B. Verify every request · C. Broad access after login · D. Least privilege · E. Perimeter only

### Domain 2

**Q3.** One password is tried against 3,000 accounts. Which attack? [M2-CANC] A. Brute force · B. Credential stuffing · C. Password spraying · D. Rainbow table

**Q4.** (numeric) A 200000 asset loses 25000 in one event. What percent is the exposure factor? [M2-CAP]

**Q5.** (rubric) Explain the first three actions after ransomware is found and justify the order. [M2-CEP]

## Answer Key

| Q | Ans | Domain | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | B | D1 | Visible cameras discourage the attempt; recording is a detective effect |
| 2 | B, D | D1 | Zero Trust verifies each request and limits access; A and C describe perimeter trust |
| 3 | C | D2 | One password against many accounts is spraying; stuffing replays leaked pairs |
| 4 | 12.5 ± 0.1 % | D2 | 25000 divided by 200000 is 0.125, which is 12.5 percent |
| 5 | Rubric | D2 | Criteria: (C1) contains the spread first; (C2) preserves evidence; (C3) justifies the order |

Scoring: 4 of 5 is a good first run.
